positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leverage AWS CloudFormation templates to deploy code and associated AWS Infrastructure. 
- Develop React frontends and Node.js backends.
- Automated testing using Playwright in CI/CD check to maintain code integrity.
- Create Micro-frontend and Micro services within a Single SPA / Piral frontend.
- Migrate AWS Lambda function to Docker for better scaling and increased performance.
- Use Claude Code and creates Skills for efficient workflow.

positions.title: Technical Specialist
positions.description:
-Backup, restore, and migrate databases for legacy and newer product offerings.
-Create and edit SQL and C# scripts to ensure data integrity during process flows. 
-Handle URL redirects and optimize Javascript for new client webpages.
-Utilize SSIS and MSSQL to verify data integrity. 
-Powershell scripting for automating database actions.

positions.title: Data Analyst II
positions.description:
-Utilize SQL and R to retrieve and manipulate data from various internal and external sources. Analyze using Tableau and/or Excel to show analytical insights. 
-Forecast credit and debit card financial projections.
-Create business cases and develop credit/debit card strategies for senior management. Collaborate with marketing for targeted campaigns and engagement opportunities. Work with compliance and audit departments to construct remediation strategies for various findings/risk events.
-Lead data mining and reports team during most recent credit processor conversion. Lends analytical support in pricing and risk strategy decisions.

positions.title: Distribution Associate
positions.description: Handles all distribution processes and inquiries for the FTFCU Corporate building in Rocklin. Communicates and escorts all outside vendors and visitors to the building. Oversees all credit union material and office supply orders for all branches and departments within First Tech. Responds and resolves all facility related issues at FTFCU Corporate, Rocklin.

positions.title: Lead Operator
positions.description: Facilitate the operation of arena sponsorships for the Sacramento Kings. Communicate with client representatives to ensure accurate management of displayed advertisement. Perform routine maintenance and analysis of production software and hardware

positions.title: Football Official
positions.description:
Responsible for player safety and fair enforcement of rules. Officiated both high school and pop warner levels.
